# Paralyzed [Condition]

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Conditions](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#ParalyzedCondition)*

While you have the Paralyzed condition, you experience the following effects.

***Incapacitated.*** You have the [Incapacitated](Incapacitated.md) condition.

***Speed 0.*** Your [Speed](../Movement/Speed.md) is 0 and can't increase.

***Saving Throws Affected.*** You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity [saving throws](../D20-Tests/Saving-Throw.md).

***Attacks Affected.*** Attack rolls against you have [Advantage](../D20-Tests/Advantage.md).

***Automatic Critical Hits.*** Any attack roll that hits you is a [Critical Hit](../Combat/Attacks/Critical-Hit.md) if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.
